div.div:
Column formula, copied by hand:
P10646 holds =ROUND(G10646*H10646,2). The formula was typed in P2 and copied down, so every row has its own copy, and nothing ensures that rows added below the data get one.

div.div:
Total: =SUM(K2:K27934)
The formula names fixed cells. Rows added below row 27934 are left out of the total, and nothing warns you.

div.div:
Calculated column:
=ROUND([@Quantity]*[@BaseListPrice],2)
One formula for the whole column. Excel fills it into every row, including rows added later.
